name: RadioButton
description: The RadioButton component provides a customizable radio input control that allows users to select one option from a group.
usage: Controlled with `checked` and `onChange(value)` (this radio's value, when it becomes the chosen one); or uncontrolled with `defaultChecked`, where the browser keeps the group's choice and onChange still fires.
Radios sharing a `name` are one native group: one Tab stop, the arrows move and select (skipping disabled radios, wrapping).
Three size options: small, medium, and large; the label takes the scale's type (sm: type-label-sm; md, lg: type-label)
Support for both text and component labels
examples:
<RadioButton
  id="small-radio"
  name="size-example"
  value="small"
  checked={selected === 'small'}
  onChange={handleChange}
  size="sm"
  label="Small"
/>

<RadioButton
  id="medium-radio"
  name="size-example"
  value="medium"
  checked={selected === 'medium'}
  onChange={handleChange}
  size="md"
  label="Medium"
/>

<RadioButton
  id="large-radio"
  name="size-example"
  value="large"
  checked={selected === 'large'}
  onChange={handleChange}
  size="lg"
  label="Large"
/>

<RadioButton
  id="disabled-radio"
  name="disabled-example"
  value="disabled"
  checked={true}
  onChange={() => {}}
  disabled={true}
  label="Disabled option"
/>

design: The RadioButton component uses CSS variables for theming:
The ring and dot are drawn from the input's :checked (peer-checked), so an uncontrolled radio unchecked by a sibling redraws without React state
Focus ring: keyboard only (focus-visible), 2px var(--color-border-focus) with offset
accessibility: Uses a standard radio input (visually hidden) for native keyboard navigation within its name group
Keyboard focus ring on the circle (peer-focus-visible, --color-border-focus with offset)
Labels are associated with inputs using htmlFor; the id is generated when left out
Disabled sets the native disabled attribute

props.name: id
props.description: The input's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: name
props.description: Group name; radios sharing it are one group (required)

props.name: value
props.description: This radio's value, passed to onChange when it is chosen (required)

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled: whether this radio is the chosen one. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Uncontrolled: chosen at first (the browser keeps the choice)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with this radio's value when it becomes the chosen one, in both modes

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the radio button is disabled

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root label (merged with cn)

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (aria-label, required, data-*, onFocus, onBlur…) goes to the input
